description: This file implements a command-line 'discover' command for a macOS application, enabling the discovery of network gateways. It includes options parsing, JSON output formatting, and gateway information display.

classes.name: DiscoveryOptions
classes.description: Holds command-line options for the discover command, with a parser to interpret arguments.

classes.name: DiscoveryOutput
classes.description: Encodable struct representing the JSON output of gateway discovery, including nested Gateway struct.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an array of command-line arguments into a DiscoveryOptions instance.

methods.name: runDiscover
methods.description: Main async function executing the discovery process: parsing options, initiating discovery, optional JSON output, and displaying results.
